temp: Temperature value of the row with its corresponding unit. Examples: '396 k', '20 C'
rh: relative humidity under which the experiment took place, unit in %. May be denoted as 'RH' or 'Humidity'.
env_other: other variables that have not been mentioned. This can contain pH values, other environment descriptors, etc.
generation: generation method used for creating droplet(s). Examples: 'spraying', 'collision', 'pipetting'
airborne_stationary: Whether droplet was aerosol or stationary.
size: size of droplet along with its unit of measurement
surface: Surface at which stationary droplets were tested on. Examples: 'plastic', 'steel', 'polystyrene'
media_desc: Description of the medium used in the experiment. May be denoted as 'sample' or 'medium'. Examples: 'PBS', 'FCS', 'saliva'
salt_val: concentration of salt content in the medium, if reported. Include unit along with measurement
time: The time value of the row, expressed as a numeric quantity followed by an optional unit. Accept numeric-only values and default to 'min' when the unit is omitted, unless the context explicitly indicates seconds ('s') or hours ('h').
